DFW lost power for 4 days during the last big storm. Are you ready for the next one?

A portable generator sitting in your garage does exactly nothing if it's not properly connected to your home. Running extension cords through a window isn't just inconvenient — it's dangerous. A generator inlet box with an interlock kit is the safe, code-compliant way to power your home when the grid goes down. We install them across DFW, pull the permits, and handle the inspection. You just plug in and flip the switch.
